Description (SPA): ADVERTENCIA: para obtener el total de votos emitidos de una carrera NO uses SUM(votes) directamente sobre esta tabla.
Description (ENG): WARNING: to get total votes cast for a race, do NOT use SUM(votes) directly on this table.
Values / Domain: See Notes column for the correct query pattern.
Notes: votos_nulos, recuadros_no_utilizados, total_votos_casilla, numero_personas_votaron and lista_nominal_casilla are per-casilla aggregate values repeated on every candidato_id row for that casilla, so summing them directly overcounts by roughly the number of candidates on that casilla's local ballot. Correct pattern: first GROUP BY (election_id, casilla_id) taking SUM(votes) as candidate_votes and MAX(votos_nulos), MAX(recuadros_no_utilizados) to collapse the per-casilla duplication, THEN sum candidate_votes + votos_nulos + recuadros_no_utilizados across casillas. Verified against official INE/Wikipedia totals for MIN_2025 (Hugo Aguilar Ortiz: 6,195,612; Lenia Batres: 5,802,019 -- exact match). SEPARATELY: total_votos_casilla is NOT a turnout/headcount figure for the four at-large races (MIN/TDJ/TEPJF_SS/TEPJF_SR) -- a voter can mark up to total_seats boxes on those ballots, so it is a sum of box-marks (confirmed: Coahuila's MIN_2025 casillas showed total_votos_casilla running ~2x lista_nominal_casilla). Use numero_personas_votaron for headcount/turnout; it reproduces published state turnout exactly (Coahuila 24.3%, Guanajuato 6.7%).

Description (SPA): Identificador surrogate generado por SQLite para cada renglon de votos en formato largo.
Description (ENG): SQLite-generated surrogate identifier for each long-format vote row.
Notes: The analytical uniqueness is election_id + casilla_id + candidato_id.

Description (SPA): Carrera judicial a la que pertenece el renglon de voto.
Description (ENG): Judicial race to which the vote row belongs.
Values / Domain: Values from dim_election.election_id (MIN_2025, TDJ_2025, TEPJF_SS_2025, TEPJF_SR_2025, TCCA_2025, JD_2025).
Notes: Required for joining facts to dimensions and for separating casilla identifiers across races.

Description (SPA): Casilla donde se registraron los votos de la candidatura.
Description (ENG): Polling station where the candidate's votes were recorded.
Values / Domain: Values matching dim_casilla.casilla_id within the same election_id.
Notes: Synthesized from (entidad, distrito federal, seccion, id_casilla, tipo_casilla_seccional), not the source CLAVE_CASILLA -- see dim_casilla.acta_casilla_mec notes.

Description (SPA): Candidatura a la que corresponde el valor de votos.
Description (ENG): Candidate to which the vote value corresponds.
Notes: Rebuilt from the same row's own scope columns rather than joined from dim_candidato_judicial during ingest, mirroring how fact_casilla_vote uses party_key as a ready-made key.

Description (SPA): Etiqueta de columna del acta que produjo este renglon.
Description (ENG): Ballot-column label that produced this row.
Values / Domain: CAND01 through CAND84, depending on the race.
Notes: Kept alongside candidato_id for readability and audit; not unique on its own -- see dim_candidato_judicial.

Description (SPA): Votos emitidos para la candidatura en la casilla especificada.
Description (ENG): Votes cast for the candidate at the specified polling station.
Notes: Core long-format vote measure. See the _GOTCHA row above for the correct total-votes query pattern.

Description (SPA): Votos nulos en la casilla, repetido en cada renglon de candidatura de esa casilla.
Description (ENG): Null votes at the polling station, repeated on every candidate row for that casilla.
Notes: NULL only for casillas the source has not yet computed. Do not SUM directly -- see _GOTCHA.

Description (SPA): Recuadros de la boleta que el elector dejo sin marcar, repetido en cada renglon de candidatura de esa casilla.
Description (ENG): Ballot boxes the voter left unmarked, repeated on every candidate row for that casilla.
Notes: Meaningful because voters can mark up to total_seats boxes per race; has no equivalent in the party-vote federal tables. Do not SUM directly -- see _GOTCHA.

Description (SPA): Total de votos asentados en el acta de la casilla para esta carrera, repetido en cada renglon de candidatura.
Description (ENG): Total votes recorded on the casilla's acta for this race, repeated on every candidate row.
Notes: Equals SUM(votes) + votos_nulos + recuadros_no_utilizados for the casilla; verified with 0 mismatches (excluding uncomputed casillas) during cleaning. Do not use this as a turnout proxy for MIN/TDJ/TEPJF_SS/TEPJF_SR: a voter can mark multiple boxes (up to total_seats), so this sums box-marks, not ballots. Use numero_personas_votaron for headcount.

Description (SPA): Numero de personas que votaron en la casilla, repetido en cada renglon de candidatura.
Description (ENG): Number of people who voted at the polling station, repeated on every candidate row.
Notes: Per-casilla aggregate; do not SUM directly.

Description (SPA): Lista nominal de la casilla, repetido en cada renglon de candidatura.
Description (ENG): Nominal voter list for the polling station, repeated on every candidate row.
Notes: Per-casilla aggregate; do not SUM directly.

Description (SPA): Marca de tiempo de insercion generada por SQLite.
Notes: Warehouse-only field; not present in clean parquet inputs.
